main_text.p: duxit; ne his quidem eft parcitum, qui quasi pacati venienti portas aperuerant: incendit præterea ædificiorum quicquid erat pulcherrimum,& demolitus mœnia,in inferiori urbe sibi arcem condidit, in Templo quoque ara posita, porcos mactauit, sacrificium à Iudæorum religione alienam, & cogebat omnes abnegato veri Dei cultu ipsius venerari numina, & oppidatim extructis Templis atque altaribus, porcinas in ijs quotidie iugulare victimas. Comminatus est etiam grauem pœnam,si quis liberos circumcideret, constitutis qui mandata exigerent, atque etiam ui ad ea seruanda detractantes cogerent.

Quamobrem, qui generosioris apud eos erant indolis, maiorem rationem habentes moris patrij, quàm pœnæ sibi per aduersarios intentatæ, quotidie necabantur, tormentis excruciati crudelissimis, (flagris quippe cæsi, & lacerati, corpora uiuorum adhuc & spirantium suffigebantur crucibus; uxores autem eorum, & circumcisos liberos, strangulabant secundum mandatum Regium, aut suspendebant à crucifixo-rum

page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The printed text is set in long-s type; long s is written as s. Ligatures æ and œ are kept as printed where they are visible. The accent on "quàm" and "à" is as printed. The word "quotidie" may carry a grave accent in print (quotidiè), which the scan does not show clearly. The line "crucifixo-" / "rum" is a word broken at the line end and is joined here. No catchword or signature is printed.
